name: Animals of the Land — Easy
description: Familiar terrestrial animals whose common names run six to ten letters long.

Big cat with rosette spots, known for hauling prey up trees
Thick-skinned grazer with one or two horns on its snout
Great ape sharing much of our DNA that uses tools
Largest land mammal, with tusks and a trunk
Largest of the great apes, chest-beating and ground-dwelling
Fastest land sprinter, marked by tear-line facial stripes
Large horned bovine of African plains or Asian wetlands
Small spiny mammal that curls into a ball for defense
Swift horned grazer of grasslands, such as an impala
Hopping Australian marsupial with a pouch
Bushy-tailed rodent that hoards nuts in trees
Small burrowing mongoose that stands upright as a sentry
Nocturnal masked mammal with a ringed tail and nimble paws
Stocky burrowing mammal with a black-and-white striped face
